name: Peter Pi
biography: Peter Pi is a Senior Security Researcher of Tencent Blade Team. He has discovered many vulnerabilities of vendors like Google, Microsoft, Apple, Qualcomm, Adobe and Tesla. He was the #1 researcher of Google Android VRP in year 2016. He has spoken at many famous security conferences such as BlackHat, CanSecWest, HITB GSEC and Hitcon. Twitter: @tencent_blade
